name: cyclop
tagline: MacBook notch app with player, shelf, clipboard, snippets, and translation
description: cyclop is a Mac app that turns the MacBook notch into a functional utility panel. It surfaces a music player, file shelf, clipboard, code snippets, calendar, and translation all from the Dynamic Island area. It is a Russian-language ecosystem project that demonstrates how much useful functionality can be packed into the notch's otherwise dead space, making it a favorite among macOS utility tinkerers.
highlights: Turns the MacBook notch into a functional utility panel
Player, file shelf, clipboard, snippets, calendar, and translation
A clever use of the notch's dead space
curatorNote: The MacBook notch is usually just wasted pixels. cyclop turns it into a genuinely useful panel, which is a fun and practical idea executed natively in Swift.
